paragraphs: Rav Shmuel bar Zutra. Shabbat 23a: Rav Shmuel bar Zutri taught, “All oils are good for ink ….” Rav Shmuel bar Zutri teaches, “All herbs are good for ink.” Sefer Melo Ratzon writes that these are two amoraim, for otherwise the Gemara would not be properly understood. Alternatively, one may say, if he is one person, and so forth. See Rav Tavut.
